title: Long Live Robin Hood
writer: Ennio De Concini, Giorgio Stegani, Manuel Torres
actors: Giuliano Gemma, Mark Damon, Luis Dávila
plot: A fun film with stylish costumes that has Gemma as the heir to the Nottingham dukedom who is robbed of his heritage. He joins the already-established 'Merrie Men' and becomes their leader.
